description: Get one recipe in full: what it takes and makes, what stays usable after a run, the settings it asks for, everything it can reach and why, where it was tested, and every file it runs.

recipe.description: A recipe's ID, owner/repo/task, such as openai/whisper/subtitles.

name: get_recipe

asks_for.description: Settings the user gives UGT, such as an API key. UGT asks for a secret in its own dialog on the user's screen, never in chat.

command.description: The same in a terminal, once UGT is installed.

files_url.description: The recipe's folder in UGT's public repository.

kind.description: job: runs once on the user's files and hands over the result. service: keeps running until stopped, with pages, endpoints, commands or MCP servers to use.

makes.description: The files it delivers, to the user's UGT folder, in UGT/<owner>/<repo>/<task>.

open_in_ugt.description: Opens the recipe in UGT on the user's computer, which shows what it runs, gives and can reach. Nothing runs until they press Run.

page_url.description: The recipe's page on usegeekthing.com, with its Open in UGT button and the line that installs UGT.

provides.description: What stays usable after a run: pages and endpoints at 127.0.0.1 on the user's computer, commands on their PATH, and MCP servers whose tools join UGT's in their AI app.

reaches.description: What it can reach beyond the files it is given, and why. Empty when it reaches only those files, with no network.

ready_built.description: true: UGT pulls the image it verified, ready-built. false: UGT builds what the recipe builds on the user's computer, exactly as it was verified, and pulls any upstream images it names by digest.

recipe.description: A recipe's ID, owner/repo/task, such as openai/whisper/subtitles.

source_url.description: The project on GitHub, at the exact commit the recipe runs.

takes.description: The files the user gives it, each placed at its path.

tested.description: Its verification on clean machines before it was admitted, by processor (amd64 for a PC or Intel Mac, arm64 for Apple silicon or Arm): its check passed on its sample and failed on broken results. A recipe runs the same way on Windows, Mac and Linux, in UGT's Linux engine.

title: Get a recipe
